caveats: Demo exchange: prices, volumes and liquidity are simulated test data, not real markets (https://docs.kalshi.com/getting_started/demo_env.md).

Candlestick OHLC is the per-period trade price plus the quoted YES bid/ask at the period open/close; fills assume the taker crosses that quote exactly and ignore book depth -- optimistic, see alerts/SPEC.md 'Fill model'.
Strategies are simulated trades; no order was sent to Kalshi (no demo API credentials exist in this repo -- COORDINATION.md I-12).
External news links are search deep-links offered as candidate catalysts; timing proximity is not evidence of causation.
